decision: A worthwhile standalone exploratory GPNMB EMC–LGFMS bulk-RNA finding survives independent numerical, scientific-value and source-coverage challenge. The scientific discovery objective is met. Authorized repository delivery requires the later exact verified remote push. The search is not exhausted.
core_result: All 13 EMC versus 13 LGFMS: medians 8.04/198.26 TPM, A_lower 0.8994. All 6 EMC versus 17 LGFMS array observations: medians 8.07341/10.33387 deposited RMA log2, A_lower 0.9020. High EMC LR5081-14 retained. Original exploratory selection, year and leave-one-out sensitivities, missingness, mixture, known/unknown overlap and MLPS nonreplication retained. No new calculation or target ranking.
value: Native histotype RNA comparison can guide LGFMS, ordinary/high EMC and malignant/myeloid/stromal/vascular compartment sampling. No protein, cell-origin, diagnostic, dependency, drug-response or clinical-benefit claim. Generic GPNMB expression in other sarcomas and endothelium is acknowledged prior art.
source_coverage: All 45 native assay conditions accounted for, not 45 independent donors; all three authenticated culture identities/four assay records evaluated. All 68 GEO/BioSample literal identities reviewed, including one already evaluated USZ23 and 67 other source-labelled histotypes. All 75 NCI conditions accounted for with 15 generic identities unresolved. Specific 16-source follow-through completed. No currently identified ready accessible authenticated relevant native GPNMB quantity is unevaluated in the checked inputs; not universal exhaustion.
negative_inconclusive: Brenca raw mixed RNA is a genuine frontier needing author run/case/preparation mapping; Davis/Zullow/Ngo/Filion/Nottley, generic models, ADC/IHC/CAR/TIC availability or native-case measurement/compartment links remain unresolved. Blocked or missing inputs are never expression-negative or novelty proof. Native-cell, HER2 clinical, proteome and fixed ALK comparison pilots yielded no independent worthwhile contribution.
validation: Nine exact Codex-owned source/figure commits, 180 frozen file bindings; original core 3258 and culture 63 independent checks reused; final role/source challenge and all-point figure 314 checks retained.
